title: Context Fabric Submission Status v1
description: The caller's own submission record (CHAOS-11913): GET /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/submissions/{submission_id}. Served to the principal that admitted the submission only; any other caller, and an unknown id, get the same 404 not_found. A client that lost a create response polls this and replays result_id when state is done.

state.description: running: the run is live. done: result_id names the final result. done_unsaved: the answer was served but not stored, so there is nothing to replay. abandoned: the run ended without an answer, or ran past its budget plus 30 seconds. No state runs the request again.

result_id.description: Present exactly when state is done: the reserved id, or the reused answer's id when the run served one. Read it with GET /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/{result_id}, which decides the read again.

thread_id.description: The X-ACR-Thread-ID the submission was admitted with, when it named one.
